label: Bible Study
prompt: For in him we live, and _____, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.
verse: For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.
note: Paul on Mars' Hill, quoting Greek poets to Athenians — meeting his audience where they lived.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: He giveth power to the _____; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.
verse: He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.
note: Strength for the faint, power for the powerless — two verses before the famous eagles' wings.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the same John had his raiment of camel's hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his meat was _____ and wild honey.
verse: And the same John had his raiment of camel's hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his meat was locusts and wild honey.
note: John the Baptist's wardrobe and menu: camel's hair, a leathern girdle, and locusts with wild honey.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Thus saith the LORD, Stand ye in the ways, and see, and ask for the old _____, where is the good way, and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls. But they said, We will not walk therein.
verse: Thus saith the LORD, Stand ye in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths, where is the good way, and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls. But they said, We will not walk therein.
note: God offers Judah the well-worn road to rest — and the verse ends with their blunt reply: 'We will not walk therein.'

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Be ye not _____ yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?
verse: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?
note: 'Unequally yoked' — like an ox and an ass in one harness, which the Law forbade (Deuteronomy 22:10).
